answer_1.quote: Our experiments with state-of-the-art models, including GPT-4 and Llama-3, reveal significant shortcomings: even the most advanced LLMs achieve only 59% accuracy on MEBench.

answer_2.quote: We adopt Accuracy (Acc) as the primary metric to assess the performance of LLMs on MEBench tasks. In addition, we evaluate performance of information extraction using Entity-Attributed F1 (EA-F1).
